calculations.population: all reported candidate rows, including duplicates and invalid rows; order preserved
calculations.interval_length_nt: validated relative end - start; nt; null for missing/invalid interval
calculations.translated_symbol_count: len(native protein_sequence); residue/stop symbols; null for missing/invalid string
calculations.protein_length_aa: len(native protein_sequence) - count('*'); amino-acid symbols, including ambiguous symbols
calculations.native_score: native_score; native model-score units; no aggregation or normalization
calculations.native_confidence_percent: native_confidence; native prediction percent; null outside [0,100] or missing
calculations.internal_stop_count: count('*' in protein_sequence[:-1]); literal markers; zero-based positions retained
calculations.terminal_stop_count: 1 if actual protein_sequence ends in '*' else 0; null if string unavailable
calculations.span_symbol_length_delta_nt: interval_length_nt - 3 * translated_symbol_count; arithmetic consistency only, not codon verification
calculations.union_coding_bases: size of union(valid relative candidate intervals), independent of strand; null if reported candidates exist but no interval is valid
calculations.coding_coverage: union_coding_bases / input_length; dimensionless; null for zero denominator or unknown numerator
calculations.partial_candidate_count: count with at least one native partial flag true; unknown flags are not false; known and unknown denominators retained
calculations.component_counts: counts of valid/missing/invalid for each of eight independently validated candidate components
calculations.combinations: interval union only; no overall score, annotation confidence or mean native score
